ref.locator: Tabel D.1 'Rekening van de overheid' (Miljoenen euro), p. 58, column 2026; rows 'a. Directe belastingen' and '- Vennootschappen'
ref.note: 111673 (Directe belastingen) - 28745 (Vennootschappen) = 82928, i.e. the rows 'Huishoudens' (81561) and 'Andere sectoren' (1368). The printed sub-rows sum to 111674 (rounding in the source); taking the total minus companies keeps the parts equal to the table total. ESA 2010 current taxes on income and wealth (D.5) paid by households, plus the small row 'Andere sectoren' (1368, all federal per Tabel D.2, not further described in the source). Per ESA 2010 §4.78(a) this covers taxes on income from work, property, self-employment and pensions, incl. tax withheld by employers (bedrijfsvoorheffing / précompte professionnel); per §4.79(d) it also covers households' payments for licences to own or use vehicles (e.g. road tax on private cars). Includes the regional and municipal surcharges (opcentiemen / centimes additionnels). Levied by (2026, Tabel D.2/D.3/D.5/D.6, households row): federal 58564, communities and regions 16383 (regional surcharges on personal income tax), local governments 5111, social security 1503; 'Andere sectoren' 1368 federal. Part of the federal amount is passed on to communities and regions under the Special Financing Act (Tabel D.3 row 'Overdrachten van fiscale ontvangsten'), so 'levied by' is not 'kept by'.

label.en: VAT, excise duties and other indirect taxes

ref.locator: Tabel D.1 'Rekening van de overheid' (Miljoenen euro), p. 58, column 2026; row 'b. Indirecte belastingen'
ref.note: The FPB gives indirect taxes only as one total, so VAT, excise duties and the rest are kept together. ESA 2010 taxes on production and imports (D.2): VAT (§4.17), excise duties and other taxes on products, incl. taxes payable when ownership of land or buildings changes (registration duties on property sales), car registration taxes, taxes on insurance premiums and on gambling (§4.20), and other taxes on production, incl. taxes on the ownership or use of buildings used in production 'including owner-occupiers of dwellings' (§4.23(a)). The Belgian national accounts book the onroerende voorheffing / précompte immobilier and its opcentiemen as D.29, not as an income tax, and the registration duties (except gift duties) as D.21 (NAI inventory pp. 230-231), so property tax and registration duties on home purchases are inside this row; gift duties are capital taxes (D.91). Levied by (2026): federal 57244 (Tabel D.2), communities and regions 9096 (Tabel D.3), local governments 8204 (Tabel D.5), social security 2562 (Tabel D.6). A large part of federal VAT is passed on to social security and the communities (e.g. alternative financing of social security from VAT, DOC 56 1278/001 pp. 38-39).

fixedNote.nl: Dit is een boekhoudkundige tegenpost, geen geld dat iemand betaalt. Volgens de Europese rekenregels (ESR 2010) staat hetzelfde bedrag ook bij de uitgaven, als deel van de beloning van het overheidspersoneel. Het weerspiegelt uitkeringen die overheden rechtstreeks aan hun (gewezen) personeel betalen. Daarom kan je het hier niet aanpassen: het verandert het tekort niet.
fixedNote.fr: Il s'agit d'une contrepartie comptable, pas d'argent versé par quelqu'un. Selon les règles comptables européennes (SEC 2010), le même montant figure aussi dans les dépenses, comme partie de la rémunération du personnel public. Il reflète les prestations que les pouvoirs publics versent directement à leur personnel (ancien ou actuel). C'est pourquoi il ne peut pas être modifié ici : il ne change pas le déficit.
fixedNote.en: This is a bookkeeping entry, not money anyone pays. Under the European accounting rules (ESA 2010), the same amount also appears on the spending side, as part of the pay of government staff. It mirrors benefits that governments pay directly to their current or former staff. That is why it cannot be changed here: it does not change the deficit.
